intro.title: Inversions
intro.text: Any note of a chord can be on the bottom. Root position C-E-G; first inversion E-G-C (the root on top); second inversion G-C-E. Same chord, different shape.

intro.title: Why
intro.text: Inversions let your hand move less between chords: bars 7–8 move from F to G to C by changing one or two fingers.

intro.title: How the mic scores this
intro.text: Keyboard mode hears chords and both hands, so every note counts. One exception: a note exactly an octave above another note in the same chord can't be told apart by any microphone, so it isn't scored.
